description: The contracted rate in cents and the governing clause for one vendor and one item (for example brake_job, tire, oil_change) on a given business day. Returns at most one contract that was valid on that day. Use it to check an invoice line against the contract.

configuration.query: FROM contracts | WHERE vendor_id == ?vendor_id AND item == ?item AND valid_from <= ?on AND valid_to >= ?on | KEEP contract_id, rate_cents, clause | LIMIT 1

vendor_id.description: Vendor id as a string, e.g. "3"

on.description: Business day number (1 = 2026-07-01, weekdays only), e.g. 44
